'''Telk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] intelligence organization, during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Telk was part of the Imperial forces that established the [[Imperial Lodgement]] in the [[Minimum Security Section]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], and shared his skills with other agents.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Telk appears as the Imperial Agent class's trainer on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
